overall: The AG found the Board violated the Open Meeting Law by failing to specify, in both the notice and the pre-session announcement, the executive session topics; ordered future compliance, no minutes relief.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Board convened an executive session at its February 9, 2016 meeting that was not listed on the posted notice.
allegations.key_passage: the Board should have specifically identified, both on the meeting notice and in the announcement prior to the executive session, that these topics would be discussed in executive session.

remedy: We order immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law and caution that future similar violations may be considered evidence of intent to violate the Law.
